messages:
deploy-bot: [change-window] Staged rollout starting for API=3.2.1, runtime=2.1.4, router=1.9.0. Plan: traffic MIRROR at 20% (no shift) for 30m in eu-west-1 then us-east-1. Pin config applied: router=1.9.0 runtime=2.1.4 api=3.2.1. Rollback triggers: 5xx > 1% sustained for 15m, error budget burn > 2% in 10m, or p95 latency +200ms vs baseline. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/staged-mirror. Owners: javi(runtime), sam(router), keisha(api). starting at 2026-03-24T00:00:00Z window until 02:00Z.
javi: ack. i'll tail runtime kv cache and warmup logs. i'll also bump the eviction threshold in a canary to avoid cold starts during warmup.
keisha: noted - API schema change includes optional field user_locale. console feature-flag must stay OFF until frontend toggle is shipped. please don't promote api to non-mirror routes until keisha says go.
sam: router team: need header-based routing for legacy clients. can we short-circuit clients with header X-Client-Version<3 to keep them on runtime 2.0.x? if not we should pin those routes before mirror starts.
devops: created temporary autoscale profile for runtime pool (scale-up aggressive for first 10m) and added metric for p95 cold-starts. also pushed policy: abort rollout if node OOM observed.
morgan: quick question — are we running any synthetic warmup traffic? if not i'll kick off a 5m warmup at +2m after mirror start.
deploy-bot: mirror started in eu-west-1 at 2026-03-24T00:07:12Z (20% mirror). Routing: header-match rule applied for new clients only. Metrics stream: https://metrics/company/staged-mirror/1755554321
keisha: seeing a tiny uptick in validation errors (0.6%) in eu-west-1 on a small subset — investigating whether schema fallback is mis-parsing new optional field.
sam: router: detecting transient 503s from edge -> router->runtime path in eu-west-1, cluster shard 3. i'm pausing router promotion for shard 3 and pinning router back to 1.8.9 for eu-west-1 shard 3 to stop client impact. pin applied: router_shard3=1.8.9
javi: runtime 2.1.4 on eu-west-1 shows KV eviction flapping; mem pressure on a few pods. i'm rolling runtime back on those pods to 2.0.9 for eu-west-1 to stabilize. runtime pin: runtime_shard3=2.0.9
deploy-bot: rollback executed for eu-west-1 shard3 at 2026-03-24T00:23:41Z. Mirror continues in other shards/regions while owners investigate. Alerts sent to #eng-oncall and #eng-sre.
keisha: after rollback, validation errors dropped back to baseline. Looks like the new optional field parsing path hit a code path we missed under the specific blob size.
morgan: confirmed warmup not run before mirror start — action item for next run: run synthetic warmup + sampling traffic for 10m pre-mirror.
devops: notes: update autoscale warmup policy and add a 3-step rollout (mirror -> small shift 5% -> bulk) in the runbook so we can exercise resource ramps.
eng-releases: summary/action items: 1) update runbook with warmup and warmcache steps (owner: morgan). 2) add header-based routing pin for legacy clients or verify fallback (owner: sam). 3) fix optional-field parsing and add unit test (owner: keisha). 4) adjust runtime eviction defaults and add mem pressure alert (owner: javi). 5) reschedule full rollout to 2026-03-26 01:00-03:00 UTC after fixes. leaving mirror active in non-affected shards. :thumbsup:
